The '''2025–26 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Middle Tennessee State University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by eighth-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]] and played their home games at [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA).

== Previous season ==
The [[2024–25 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 22–12, 12–6 in C-USA play to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2025 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] they defeated [[2024–25 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]] in quarterfinals before losing to [[2024–25 Jacksonville State Gamecocks men's basketball team|Jacksonville State]] in the semifinals. They received an invitation to the [[2025 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the Dayton region. The Blue Raiders lost to [[2024–25 Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball team|Chattanooga]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Joyce |first=Cecil |title=How MTSU men's basketball ended season with triple-overtime loss to Chattanooga in NIT |url=https://www.dnj.com/story/sports/college/mtsu/2025/03/18/mtsu-men-basketball-chattanooga-nit-live-updates-scores-tv/82480760007/ |access-date=2025-11-15 |website=The Daily News Journal |language=en-US}}</ref>
